title: D-06 public forms radio and date field slice
status: slice shipped; D point and Visual Editor remain open
changes: Added radio/date to the versioned first-party form schema.
Radio options use the existing bounded option list and submissions reject values outside the allowlist.
Date submissions require YYYY-MM-DD and a real calendar date; leap day is validated and year 0000 rejected.
The Inspector edits both types, shows options only for select/radio, and hides irrelevant max-length controls.
The public renderer provides a labelled radio fieldset, native date input and scalar form values.
Bumped only the affected editor/public cache keys; form Save remains separate from form Publish and page Save/Publish.
